name: Aqua
source:
Believe it or not, Aqua is the 2nd oldest member of the Circle of Eden. Her lack of seriousness made her the most approachable of the Five Witches, but also the target of the harassment of some vile people. She would always find a way in her heart to forgive those that wronged her. Do not underestimate this woman, what she lacks in size, she makes up for it with incredibly precise and quick attacks.

[In game description]
